disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant lacks one or more qualifications specified in this chapter for a license or appointment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lacks one or more of the qualifications specified in this chapter for a license or appointment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made a material misstatement, misrepresentation, or fraud in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or appointment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made a material misstatement, misrepresentation, or fraud in obtaining a license or appointment, or in attempting to obtain a license or appointment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pass any examination required under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to pass any examination required under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully used the license or appointment to circumvent any requirements or prohibitions of this chapter or the insurance code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully used, or intended the use, of the license or appointment to circumvent any of the requirements or prohibitions of this chapter or the insurance code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated lack of fitness or trustworthiness to engage in the bail bond business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated lack of fitness or trustworthiness to engage in the bail bond business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated lack of reasonably adequate knowledge and technical competence to engage in the authorized transactions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated lack of reasonably adequate knowledge and technical competence to engage in the transactions authorized by the license or appointment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraudulent or dishonest practices in the conduct of business under the license or appointment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in fraudulent or dishonest practices in the conduct of business under the license or appointment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of misappropriation, conversion, or unlawful withholding of moneys belonging to a surety, principal, or others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of misappropriation, conversion, or unlawful withholding of moneys belonging to a surety, a principal, or others and received in the conduct of business under a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of rebating or offering to rebate, or unlawfully dividing or offering to divide any commission or premiums.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of rebating or offering to rebate, or unlawfully dividing or offering to divide, any commission, in the case of a limited surety agent, or premiums, in the case of a professional bail bond agent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failed to comply with or willfully violated any proper order or rule of the department, or willfully violated any provision of this chapter or the insurance code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully failed to comply with or willfully violated any proper order or rule of the department or willfully violated any provision of this chapter or the insurance code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of or pleaded guilty or no contest to a felony, crime involving moral turpitude, or crime punishable by imprisonment of 1 year or more.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty of, or has pleaded guilty or no contest to a felony, a crime involving moral turpitude, or a crime punishable by imprisonment of 1 year or more under the law of any state, territory, or country, whether or not a judgment or conviction has been entered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated lack of good faith in carrying out contractual obligations and agreements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated lack of good faith in carrying out contractual obligations and agreements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to perform a contractual obligation with a managing general agent or insurer resulting in an unrecovered loss due to nonpayment of forfeiture or judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to perform a contractual obligation or agreement with a managing general agent or insurer which results in an unrecovered loss due to nonpayment of a forfeiture or judgment by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to return collateral.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to return collateral.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signed and filed a false or misleading report, willfully failed to file a required report, or obstructed such filing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has signed and filed a report or record in the capacity of an agent which the licensee knows to be false or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated a course of conduct or practices indicating incompetence, negligence, or dishonesty such that client property cannot safely be entrusted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated a course of conduct or practices which indicate that the licensee is incompetent, negligent, or dishonest or that property or rights of clients cannot safely be entrusted to him or her.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on an examination required for licensure or violating test center rules or examination procedures.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on an examination required for licensure or violating test center rules or examination procedures published orally or in writing at the test site by authorized representatives of the examination program administrator.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to pay over to any insurer money belonging to the insurer received in the course of business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal, upon demand, to pay over to any insurer the bail bond agent represents or has represented any money coming into his or her hands which money belongs to the insurer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found to be a source of injury or loss to the public or detrimental to the public interest, or no longer carrying on bail bond business in good faith.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found to be a source of injury or loss to the public or detrimental to the public interest or being found by the department to be no longer carrying on the bail bond business in good faith.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interfering or attempting to interfere with the administration of justice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interfering or attempting to interfere with the administration of justice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged bankrupt or insolvent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grounds for revocation of the license or appointment exist when any licensee is adjudged bankrupt or insolvent.

apprehending, arresting, and surrendering defendants to proper authorities
methods_authorized.quote: The issuance of a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter shall confer upon the holder the right to perform all duties and powers as authorized or conferred by the laws of this state.

agent_type_tiers.quote: "Bail bond agent" means a limited surety agent or a professional bail bond agent as hereafter defined.

bail_enforcement_agent_license_available.quote: A person, other than a certified law enforcement officer, may not apprehend, detain, or arrest a principal on a bond, wherever issued, unless that person is qualified, licensed, and appointed as provided in this chapter or licensed as a bail bond agent or bail bond enforcement agent, or holds an equivalent license by the state where the bond was written.

managing_general_agent_required.quote: Any insurer regularly engaged in the execution of bail bonds in this state shall have a managing general agent in this state to supervise its agents.

power_of_attorney_required.quote: every insurer engaged in the writing of bail bonds through bail bond agents in this state shall submit to the office for prior approval a sample power of attorney, which shall be the only form of power of attorney the insurer issues to bail bond agents in this state.

premium_rate_filed_and_approved.quote: the premium rate may not exceed or be less than the premium rate as filed with and approved by the office.

collateral_receipt_required.quote: When a bail bond agent accepts collateral, a written, numbered receipt shall be given, and this receipt shall give in detail a full account of the collateral received.

collateral_held_in_fiduciary_capacity.quote: Collateral security shall be received and held in the insurer's name by the bail bond agent in a fiduciary capacity and, prior to any forfeiture of bail, shall be kept separate and apart from any other funds or assets of such bail bond agent.

collateral_return_deadline_days.quote: the collateral shall be returned to the indemnitor within 21 days after the discharge is provided.

large_cash_collateral_threshold_and_hand.value: Cash collateral over $50,000 per bond must be forwarded to insurer as cashier's check, U.S. postal money order, certificates of deposit, or wire transfer. Cash collateral over $5,000 must be immediately forwarded to the insurer.
large_cash_collateral_threshold_and_hand.quote: A bail bond agent may accept collateral security in excess of $50,000 cash per bond, provided any amount over $50,000 cash is payable to the insurer in the form of a cashier's check, United States postal money order, certificates of deposit, or wire transfer and is remitted to and held by the insurer.

quitclaim_deed_as_collateral_prohibited.quote: A quitclaim deed for property may not be taken as collateral.

value: No solicitation in or on the property or grounds of a jail, prison, or other place where prisoners are confined
No solicitation in or on the property or grounds of any court
No in-person or telephone solicitation after 9:00 p.m. or before 8:00 a.m. at the residence of the detainee or the detainee's family
No bail bond business with any person other than the defendant on the grounds of the jail or courthouse for the purpose of executing a bond
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Directly or indirectly solicit business in or on the property or grounds of a jail, prison, or other place where prisoners are confined or in or on the property or grounds of any court.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Suggest or advise the employment of, or name for employment, any particular attorney or attorneys to represent his or her principal.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to a jailer, police officer, peace officer, or committing trial court judge or any other person who has power to arrest or to hold in custody or to any public official or public employee in order to secure a settlement, compromise, remission, or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or estreatment thereof.

law_enforcement_prohibited_from_acting_a.quote: The following persons or classes may not be bail bond agents or employees of a bail bond agent or a bail bond agency and may not directly or indirectly receive any benefits from the execution of any bail bond: (a) Jailers or persons employed in any jail. (b) Police officers or employees of any police department or law enforcement agency.

impersonation_of_government_official_pro.quote: Wear or display any identification other than the department issued or approved license or approved department identification, which includes a citation of the licensee's arrest powers, in or on the property or grounds of a jail, prison, or other place where prisoners are confined or in or on the property or grounds of any court.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: Any bail bond agent that surrenders or recommits a defendant must provide the defendant with a statement of surrender on a department-prescribed form. The statement must be signed by the agent and must state the reason for surrender.

unpaid_forfeiture_judgment_limit.quote: Execute a bond in this state if a judgment has been entered on a bond executed by the bail bond agent or the bail bond agency is a named party on the judgment, which has remained unpaid for 35 days, unless the full amount of the judgment is deposited with the clerk in accordance with s. 903.27(5).

agency_ownership_experience_requirement.quote: A person may not own, control, manage, or otherwise have a pecuniary interest in a bail bond agency unless such individual is licensed pursuant to s. 648.27, appointed through the department, and actively engaged as a bail bond agent for at least the preceding 24 months.
